context: Evaluates correct implementation of the useIntersectionObserver hook from visionarias-client. The hook must create an IntersectionObserver using the provided options, attach it to a ref element, track visibility state, support the freezeOnceVisible option, and clean up the observer on unmount.

checklist.name: Returns [ref, boolean]
checklist.description: Returns a tuple with a React ref object and a boolean isVisible state value

checklist.name: IntersectionObserver creation
checklist.description: Creates a new IntersectionObserver instance inside useEffect, passing a callback that updates isVisible based on entry.isIntersecting

checklist.name: Options forwarded
checklist.description: Forwards threshold, rootMargin, and root options from the hook parameter to the IntersectionObserver constructor

checklist.name: freezeOnceVisible support
checklist.description: When freezeOnceVisible is true, the observer is disconnected after the element first becomes visible and isVisible stays true

checklist.name: Observer cleanup
checklist.description: useEffect cleanup function calls observer.disconnect() to prevent memory leaks on unmount
